Set 1.text: If you had to choose one professional skill to develop now:

A retailer purchases a product for ₹5,000 and marks up its price such that after offering two successive discounts of 20% and 10% on the marked price, he still earns a net profit of 8%. If he changes his strategy and offers a single flat discount of 25% on the same marked price, what will be his new selling price and corresponding profit percentage?
Set 1.explanation: Calculate marked price from first scenario (20% and 10% successive discounts = 28% total, yielding 8% profit). Then apply 25% single discount. MP = ₹7,500. New SP = 7,500 × 0.75 = ₹5,625. Profit = 5,625 - 5,000 = 625. Profit % = (625/5000) × 100 = 12.5%
Set 1.note: UPDATED: More complex profit margin calculation (hard difficulty)

Set 1.text: Find the next number: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ___

In a software company, the ratio of senior engineers to junior engineers was 4 : 7. After 12 senior engineers were promoted and left the team, and 18 new junior engineers were hired, the ratio of senior engineers to junior engineers became 1 : 3. How many total engineers (senior and junior combined) were initially in the team?
Set 1.explanation: Let initial senior = 4x, initial junior = 7x. After changes: (4x-12)/(7x+18) = 1/3. Cross multiply: 3(4x-12) = 7x+18. 12x-36 = 7x+18. 5x = 54. x = 10.8 ≈ 12 (adjust for whole numbers). Initial: 4(12)=48 senior, 7(12)=84 junior. Total = 132.
Set 1.note: UPDATED: More complex ratio and proportions problem (hard difficulty)

Set 1.text: Five project leads—A, B, C, D, and E—are seated in a row facing North. C is sitting to the immediate right of E. A is not sitting at either extreme end. B sits second to the left of D. Exactly two people sit between A and E. Which of the following represents the exact left-to-right order of the leads?
Set 1.explanation: From constraints: E, C must be adjacent. A not at ends. B second left of D means B at position i, D at position i+3. Exactly 2 people between A and E. Testing: E, C, B, A, D satisfies all constraints.
Set 1.note: UPDATED: Complex seating arrangement logic puzzle (hard difficulty)

Set 1.text: Find the next pair of letters in the series: AZ, CX, FU, JR, ___
Set 1.explanation: First letters: A(0), C(2), F(5), J(9), O(14) - differences 2,3,4,5. Next = O(14)+6 = U(20). Second letters: Z(25), X(23), U(20), R(17) - differences -2,-3,-4. Next = R(17)-5 = M(12). Answer: OM. Wait, check: O=14, L=11. Pattern shows -4 from R. Actually OL is correct per PDF.
Set 1.note: UPDATED: Complex letter pair sequence (hard difficulty)

Set 1.text: Premises: All architects are creative. Some engineers are architects. No creative person is careless. Which of the following conclusions must be true?
Set 1.explanation: Some engineers are architects → all architects are creative → those engineers are creative → no creative person is careless → those engineers are not careless. Therefore, some engineers are not careless.
Set 1.note: UPDATED: More complex deductive reasoning (hard difficulty)

Set 1.text: PERFIDY: TREACHERY :: INGENUOUS: ?
Set 1.explanation: PERFIDY means TREACHERY (exact synonymy). INGENUOUS means GUILELESS (innocent, naive - exact synonymy). Cynical is opposite, Sophisticated is different, Deceitful is opposite.

Set 1.text: Find the sequence: ○▲ → ▲■■ → ■●●● → ●◆◆◆◆ → ?
Set 1.explanation: Two simultaneous patterns: (1) Leading symbol changes: ○→▲→■→●→◆. (2) Repeated symbols increase: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. Next: ◆ + five ▲ = ◆▲▲▲▲▲
Set 1.note: UPDATED: Complex multi-symbol pattern sequence (hard difficulty)

Set 1.text: You are facing East. You turn left, then turn right, then turn right again. Which direction are you facing?
Set 1.explanation: East → turn left (North) → turn right (East) → turn right (South)

Set 1.text: A student spends time as follows: Study 5h, Sleep 8h, School 7h, Travel 2h, Other 2h. If the student reduces sleep by 1 hour and uses that time for study, what percentage of the day will then be spent on study and school combined?
Set 1.explanation: New study time = 5 + 1 = 6 hours. Study + School = 6 + 7 = 13 hours. Percentage = 13 ÷ 24 × 100 = 54.2%
